blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Four senator-judges called out defense lawyer Mark Vinluan on Monday for raising possible administrative and criminal liability against those who disclose and report confidential information, including the media. During his cross-examination of prosecution witness Atty. Ronel Buenaventura, executive director of the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat, Vinluan enumerated the penalties under the Anti-Money Laundering Act. “Based on this provision, Atty. Buenaventura, penalties involve both administrative and criminal sanctions. Correct?” Vintuan asked the witness, after citing the specific provision of the law.
